meaning:
συν-παρα-καλέω (Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ,
to call upon or exhort together (Plat.). Pass., to be strengthened or comforted with and among: Rom.1:12.†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: that I may be comforted together

elsewhere.note: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.
